or start here

Live inspection sends public account addresses to Solana’s public RPC. Imported files stay in this browser tab. No keys, signing, analytics, or browser storage.

Bring your own account snapshot

Browser RPC blocked? From your LaunchOps checkout, export a snapshot using the CLI and then choose Import accounts. 

node bin/launchops.mjs fees --mint PUBLIC_MINT --snapshot-out accounts.json

Use a new filename. Set your provider through the CLI’s SOLANA_RPC_URL environment variable; keep credentials out of browser inputs and shared files.

Snapshot guide and limits

Evidence, with its limits

This is a snapshot of supported accounts, not complete history. A pool observation does not prove liquidity, tradability, or token safety.

          How to prepare an evidence file
          
        
            Import a positano.launch-evidence.v1 JSON export, or a
            saved token scan from our community-tools fork. Maximum file size 5
            MB. Files are processed locally; this viewer makes no history
            requests.
          
        
          
        node evidence/cli.mjs scan.json evidence.json
        
          
        
            The exporter is in
            Pumpfun Community Tools. Older scans can lack transaction-level evidence and remain
            unknown. This release does not fetch arbitrary mint history,
            identify whale ownership, or monitor future exits.
